The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1901–1902''' was contested by fifteen teams participating in two divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern and western football division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[HVV Den Haag]] won this year's championship by beating [[GVC Wageningen|Victoria Wageningen]] 2-2, 3–1.

==New entrant==
'''Eerste Klasse West:'''
*[[Koninklijke HFC]] returned after one season of absence
